blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Patient-specific 4D myocardial reconstruction from cine MRI supports quantitative functional assessment, regional motion analysis, and simulation-based modeling. However, routinely acquired short-axis (SAX) cine MRI is sparsely sampled along the through-plane direction, making dense and anatomically consistent surface reconstruction challenging. In this study, we propose an anatomy-aligned surface learning framework that parameterizes the epicardial and endocardial surfaces on a shared circumferential-longitudinal UV domain . This formulation converts irregular 3D reconstruction into structured coordinate-field completion with explicit correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases. Sparse SAX contours are encoded as UV observation fields, coverage-aware sampling improves robustness to incomplete slice coverage, and topology- and distortion-aware learning preserves circumferential continuity and local surface quality. Experiments on three public cine MRI datasets showed that the proposed method consistently outperformed representative mesh-based and implicit reconstruction approaches, achieving overall Chamfer distances of 2.887 2.887 mm on ACDC, 2.641 2.641 mm on M&Ms, and 2.810 2.810 mm on M&Ms-2. The reconstructed sequences also preserved ventricular function, with end-diastolic volume and ejection fraction errors of 3.3 3.3 mL and 1.1 % 1.1\% , respectively. These results demonstrate that anatomy-aligned UV learning provides an accurate, efficient, and correspondence-aware representation for sparse cine MRI reconstruction and myocardial modeling. The source code will be available at https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf .

blocks.en:
Patient-specific 4D (3D+t) myocardial mesh reconstruction is fundamental for quantitative cardiovascular analysis ( Qiao et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2024a ) .
Compared with image-based measurements alone, surface-based representations provide explicit anatomical geometry and enable downstream analyses such as spatial correspondence, regional functional mapping, and simulation-based modeling.
In routine clinical imaging, cine MRI is commonly acquired as short-axis (SAX) slices, which provide high in-plane resolution but limited through-plane coverage along the long-axis direction ( Li et al., 2023 ) .
Recovering a geometrically smooth and anatomically plausible myocardial surface from such sparse SAX observations remains challenging because geometric evidence is limited to sparse SAX planes.
blocks.zh:
患者特异性4D(3D+t)心肌膜重建是定量心血管分析的基础(Qiao等人,2025a;Liu等人,2026;Li等人,2024a).
与仅基于图像的测量相比,地表表示提供了明确的解剖几何,并使得下游分析成为可能,如空间对应,区域功能绘图,模拟模型.
在常规临床成像中,焚化核磁共振通常作为短轴(SAX)切片获得,该片在飞机中具有较高的分辨率,但沿长轴方向的通过飞机覆盖范围有限(Li等人,2023年).
从这种稀少的SAX观测中恢复一个几何光滑和解剖上可能存在的心肌表面仍然具有挑战性,因为几何证据仅限于稀少的SAX飞机。

blocks.en:
Existing learning-based myocardial reconstruction methods can be broadly grouped into explicit mesh deformation and implicit field prediction.
Mesh-based methods typically deform a predefined template by regressing vertex-wise displacements, often using graph neural networks, mesh convolution, or differentiable projection losses to constrain the reconstructed surface ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Gaggion et al., 2025 ) .
These methods have shown promising performance when dense annotations, multi-view images, or strong projection constraints are available.
However, under sparse SAX supervision, image evidence is only observed at a limited number of slice locations, making it difficult to propagate local contour information coherently across the entire ventricular surface.
Moreover, vertex-space learning provides consistent topology but lacks an explicit anatomical coordinate system for organizing sparse SAX observations along the myocardial circumferential and longitudinal directions.
Implicit reconstruction methods alleviate some of these limitations by predicting continuous occupancy, signed distance, or coordinate fields in 3D space, thereby improving smoothness and topology preservation ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) .
Nevertheless, most implicit methods still operate in generic Euclidean coordinates and do not explicitly exploit the intrinsic anatomical organization of the myocardium.
This is suboptimal for the left ventricle (LV), which exhibits a well-defined circumferential-longitudinal structure with approximately cylindrical topology .
Such intrinsic coordinates have been used for regional partitioning, cardiac mechanics, and quantitative cardiac MRI analysis ( Bayer et al., 2018 ; Schuler et al., 2021 ) .
In computer graphics and human/object surface modeling, surface parameterization has been widely used to represent complex 3D surfaces on structured 2D domains ( Güler et al., 2018 ; Zuffi et al., 2017 ; Huang et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) .
However, using such a surface domain to jointly organize sparse SAX observations and dense reconstruction targets remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
现有的基于学习的心肌重建方法可以大致分为明确的网状变形和隐含的场状预测.
基于网格的方法通常通过倒置顶点向外移来变形预先定义的模板,经常使用图神经网络,网格演化,或不同的投影损失来约束重建的表面(Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年;Lo等人,2026年;Gaggion等人,2025年).
这些方法在有密集的注解,多视图图像,或强烈的投影限制时,显示出有希望的表现.
然而,在很少的SAX监督下,只在有限的切片地点观察到图像证据,因此很难在整个通风口表面连贯地传播当地轮廓信息。
此外,顶点-空间学习提供了一致的地形学,但缺乏明确的解剖坐标系统,无法沿着心肌环绕和纵向方向组织稀少的SAX观测。
隐含的重建方法通过预测连续占用,签名距离,或协调3D空间的田野,从而改善平滑性和地形保护,减轻了其中的一些局限性(陈等人,2024年;傅等人,2025年;孙等人,2022年;袁等人,2023年;叶等人,2023年).
尽管如此,大多数隐含的方法仍然在通用的欧几利得坐标中运作,并且没有明确利用心肌的内在解剖组织.
这对左侧通风(LV)来说是次优的,它呈现出一个定义清晰的圆柱形地形结构。
此类内在坐标被用于区域分隔、心脏力学和定量心脏核磁共振分析(Bayer等人,2018年;Schuler等人,2021年)。
在计算机图形和人/物体表面模型化中,表面参数化被广泛用于在结构化的2D域上代表复杂的3D表面(Güler等人,2018年;Zuffi等人,2017年;Huang等人,2022年;Zhao等人,2023年;Hu等人,2024年).
然而,利用这样一个地表域来联合组织稀少的SAX观测和密集的重建目标仍然没有得到充分利用.

blocks.en:
In this study, we introduce an anatomy-aligned surface learning framework for reconstructing dense 3D myocardial surfaces from sparse SAX cine MRI.
The proposed method reformulates myocardial reconstruction from sparse slice observations as continuous 3D coordinate field estimation on a shared two-dimensional anatomical surface domain.
Specifically, we parameterize the LV surface using a circumferential-longitudinal UV domain , where the u u coordinate follows the circumferential direction and the v v coordinate follows the longitudinal base-to-apex direction.
This representation establishes anatomical correspondence across subjects and converts irregular 3D surface reconstruction into structured surface field learning.
Sparse SAX contours are further lifted into the UV domain as observation fields, providing spatially coherent geometric conditioning from discontinuous slice measurements.
To respect the cylindrical topology of the LV, we incorporate explicit periodic modeling along the circumferential direction.
To our knowledge, this is the first sparse-SAX reconstruction framework to represent both observations and target surfaces as dense fields on the same anatomy-aligned UV domain.
The main contributions of this work are: • We introduce an anatomy-aligned UV representation that reformulates sparse-SAX myocardial reconstruction as structured coordinate-field learning with explicit correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases. • We propose a contour-to-UV encoder that maps discontinuous SAX contours into surface-aligned observation fields, together with coverage-aware sampling for incomplete slice coverage. • We develop a topology- and distortion-aware completion network that combines circumferential wrap convolution with region-focused geometric regularization for coherent epicardial and endocardial reconstruction. • We validate the framework on three public cine MRI datasets, demonstrating accurate and efficient 3D/4D myocardial reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们引入了一个解剖学与表层结合的学习框架,用于从稀疏的SAX cine核磁共振中重建密集的3D心肌表面.
提议的方法将心肌重建从稀少的切片观测中重新形成,作为共享二维解剖面域上连续的3D协调场估计.
具体地说,我们使用一个环形-长图紫外线域来参数化LV表面,其中u u 坐标遵循环形方向,v 坐标遵循纵向基到角方向.
这种表示法建立了跨主体的解剖对应,并将不规则的立体表面重建转化为结构化的表面野外学习.
Sparse SAX轮廓作为观测场被进一步提升到紫外线域中,通过断断续续的切片测量提供空间连贯的几何条件.
为了尊重LV的圆柱形地形,我们沿环形方向加入了明确的周期模型.
据我们所知,这是第一个在同一个解剖学相通的紫外线域上既代表观测结果又代表目标表面的稀疏-SAX重建框架.
这项工作的主要贡献是: 我们引入了解剖学与紫外线结合的表述,将稀疏的SAX心肌重建重新编订为结构化的协调-实地学习,在学科和心脏阶段之间明确对应。 我们提议采用轮廓到紫外线编码器,将不连续的SAX轮廓映射到地表相通的观测场,同时进行覆盖-认识取样,以进行不完整的片面覆盖。 我们发展了一个地形学和失真意识的完成网络,将环绕式综合体与以区域为重点的几何规范化结合起来,以进行连贯的心动和心动重建。 我们验证三个公共焚烧磁共振数据集的框架,显示3D/4D心肌重建准确而高效。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D/4D Cardiac Reconstruction from Cine MRI
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维/4D Cine MRI的心脏重建

blocks.en: Existing 3D/4D cardiac reconstruction methods can be broadly categorized into explicit surface modeling, implicit continuous representations, and generative shape modeling. Explicit approaches recover patient-specific anatomy by deforming fixed-topology meshes, templates, or statistical shape models. Representative methods include the MulViMotion series ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) , Mesh4D ( Qiao et al., 2025b ) , HeartSSM ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , and atlas-based frameworks ( Sinclair et al., 2022 ) . Subsequent studies incorporated point-cloud deformation ( Beetz et al., 2024 ) , CT-derived priors ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , differentiable slicing ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , graph-based refinement ( Gaggion et al., 2025 ) , and statistical shape constraints ( Joyce et al., 2022 ; Xia et al., 2022 ) . Although these methods provide explicit and interpretable surfaces, they often depend on multi-view imaging, dense supervision, or strong geometric priors, which limits their applicability to sparse SAX-only acquisitions.
blocks.zh: 现有的3D/4D心脏重建方法可以大致分为明显的表面模型,隐含的连续表示,以及基因形状模型. 明确的方法通过变形的固定地形介质,模板或统计形状模型来恢复患者特有的解剖学. 代表性方法包括MulViMotion系列(Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年),Mesh4D (Qiao等人,2025年b), HeartSSM (Ma等人,2026年),和基于地图集的框架(Sinclair等人,2022年). 随后的研究包括点云变形(Beetz等人,2024年),CT派生前科(徐等人,2024年),异形切片(Luo等人,2026年),以图表为基础的改进(Gaggion等人,2025年),以及统计形状限制。 (Joyce等人,2022年;Xia等人,2022年). 尽管这些方法提供了清晰和可解释的表面,但它们往往依赖于多视图成像,密集的监控,或强的几何前缀,这限制了其适用于稀少的仅SAX的获取.

blocks.en:
Implicit approaches instead represent cardiac anatomy and motion using continuous fields or deformable domains, including dynamic Gaussian representations ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , topology-preserving implicit registration ( Sun et al., 2022 ) , disentangled shape-motion models ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) , neural deformation fields ( Ye et al., 2023 ) , and deformable tetrahedral models ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . NIHC ( Muffoletto et al., 2025 ) further introduced anatomically coherent implicit coordinates based on universal ventricular coordinates.
In contrast, our formulation explicitly lifts sparse SAX contours into dense surface-aligned observation fields for direct UV-domain completion.
Generative models have also been explored for dynamic shape synthesis, surface completion, and virtual population modeling ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Qiao et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Their emphasis, however, is primarily on distribution learning rather than directly reconstructing dense myocardial surfaces from sparse SAX observations while preserving explicit anatomical correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases.
blocks.zh:
相反,隐形方法是指利用连续字段或变形域进行心脏解剖和运动,包括动态高斯表示(Fu等人,2025年),地形保留隐性登记(Sun等人,2022年),分解的形状运动模型(Yuan等人,2023年),神经变形场(Ye等人,2023年),以及可变形的四面体模型(Chen等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年)。 NIHC(Muffoletto等人,2025年)在通用通风坐标的基础上进一步引入了解剖学上一致的隐含坐标.
与此相反,我们的配方明确将稀疏的SAX轮廓抬入密集的地表对流观测场,以便直接完成紫外线。
还探讨了动态形状合成、表面完成和虚拟人口模型的基因模型(Ma等人,2025年;Qiao等人,2025年a); 张等,2025;杨等,2026). 然而,它们的重点主要是分布学习,而不是直接从稀少的SAX观测中重建密集的心肌表面,同时保留不同学科和心脏阶段之间的明确解剖对应.

blocks.en: 2.2 Anatomical Coordinates and Canonical Surface Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 解剖学坐标和运河表面表象

blocks.en:
Cardiac anatomical coordinate systems have been widely used for regional partitioning, functional analysis, and quantitative modeling.
For example, the AHA 17-segment model provides a standardized regional reference for analyzing myocardial perfusion, motion abnormalities, and scar distribution ( Li et al., 2024b ) .
Universal ventricular coordinates ( Bayer et al., 2018 ) and Cobiveco ( Schuler et al., 2021 ) further construct continuous anatomical coordinate systems for establishing correspondences across cardiac models for cross-subject functional comparison.
However, these coordinate systems are typically used as post-processing analysis tools, simulation coordinate systems, or registration reference spaces, and have rarely been adopted as the primary learning domain for reconstruction models under sparse observations.
In general computer vision and graphics, canonical UV representations are widely used to unfold deformable 3D surfaces into cross-instance consistent 2D parameter domains, thereby transforming irregular surface learning into image-like representation learning.
Representative works, such as DensePose ( Güler et al., 2018 ) , canonical animal/human surface modeling ( Zuffi et al., 2017 ) , and SUPPLE ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , demonstrate the advantages of UV representations in dense correspondence, geometric alignment, and cross-instance structural modeling.
Nevertheless, these methods are mainly designed for natural images, dense surface observations, or texture-based supervision, and have not been fully explored for sparse medical image-based reconstruction ( Geng et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
心动解剖坐标系统被广泛用于区域分割,功能分析和定量模型.
例如,AHA 17分区模型为分析心肌输血、运动异常和疤痕分布提供了一个标准化的区域参考(Li等人,2024年b)。
环球通风坐标(Bayer等人,2018年)和Cobiveco(Schuler等人,2021年)进一步构建连续解剖坐标系统,用于建立跨心脏模型的对应关系,用于交叉主体功能比较.
然而,这些坐标系统通常被用作处理后分析工具,模拟坐标系统,或注册参考空间,很少被采用作为稀有观测下重建模型的初级学习领域.
在一般的计算机视觉和图形中,Canonical UV表示法被广泛用于将可变形的3D表面展开到交叉内相一致的2D参数域,从而将不规则的表面学习转化为像图像一样的表达学习.
代表性作品如DensePose(Güler等人,2018年),犬类动物/人类表面模型(Zuffi等人,2017年),SUPPLE(Zhao等人,2023年)等,展现了紫外线表现在密集函证,几何对齐,跨内线结构模型中的优点.
尽管如此,这些方法主要是为自然影像,密集的表面观测,或纹理监督而设计的,还没有为稀疏的医学影像重建进行充分探索(Geng等人,2023年;Hu等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overall pipeline of the proposed anatomy-aligned UV myocardial surface reconstruction framework. Sparse SAX contours are aligned to the canonical template and encoded as epicardial and endocardial UV observation fields, with coverage-aware sampling used during training. A topology- and distortion-aware UV network completes the patient-specific surface fields through circumferential WrapConv2D and region-focused geometric supervision, followed by explicit mesh reconstruction using fixed UV connectivity.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the proposed framework reconstructs patient-specific myocardial surfaces from SAX contours through three key components. First, the epicardial and endocardial surfaces are represented as 3D coordinate fields on a shared anatomy-aligned UV domain (Sec. 3.1 ). Second, sparse SAX contours are transformed into surface-aligned observation fields through anatomical correspondence retrieval and soft cross-slice aggregation, with coverage-aware sampling introduced during training (Sec. 3.2 ). Third, a periodic UV-domain network completes the two surface fields, while topology- and distortion-aware constraints preserve circumferential continuity and suppress local geometric artifacts. The predicted coordinate fields are finally converted into explicit meshes using fixed UV connectivity (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,拟议框架通过三个关键组成部分,从SAX轮廓重建患者特有的心肌表面。 首先,心跳和内心表面作为3D坐标场在共享的解剖学对齐的紫外线域(Sec. 3.1 )上代表. 第二,稀疏的SAX轮廓通过解剖通信检索和柔软的交叉切片聚合而转化为地表对齐观测场,在训练中引入了覆盖感-感光采样(第3.2条)。 第三,一个周期性的紫外线域网可以完成两个表面域,而地形学和扭曲意识的制约则能保持周密的连续性,压制局部几何文物. 预言的坐标域最终通过固定的紫外线连接(Sec.3.3 )转换成显式网格.

blocks.en: 3.1 Anatomy-Aligned UV Surface Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 解剖学-与紫外线相适应的表面分布

A myocardial template ( Bai et al., 2015 ) provides consistent topology and vertex correspondence across subjects and phases. Its UV parameterization is constructed once and shared across all reference and predicted surfaces, such that the same UV location corresponds to the same anatomical position across subjects and cardiac phases. Specifically, we define the canonical domain as Ω = { ( u , v ) ∣ u ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) , v ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] } , \Omega=\left\{(u,v)\mid u\in[0,1),\;v\in[0,1]\right\}, (1) where u u is the periodic circumferential coordinate and v v is the
longitudinal coordinate from the base to the apex. For each surface s ∈ { epi , endo } s\in\{\mathrm{epi},\mathrm{endo}\} , the parameterization is defined as Φ s : 𝒮 s template → Ω , 𝐱 ↦ ( u s ​ ( 𝐱 ) , v s ​ ( 𝐱 ) ) . \Phi_{s}:\mathcal{S}^{\mathrm{template}}_{s}\rightarrow\Omega,\qquad\mathbf{x}\mapsto\left(u_{s}(\mathbf{x}),v_{s}(\mathbf{x})\right). blocks.en: 3.2 Sparse SAX Contour-to-UV Observation Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2 Sparse SAX 对紫外线观测模型

blocks.en: The canonical UV representation defines the reconstruction target but does not directly organize the sparse SAX contour observations. We therefore first transform the discontinuous contours into observation fields on the same anatomy-aligned domain, and further introduce coverage-aware slice sampling to improve robustness to varying longitudinal coverage.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Coverage-Aware Slice Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 覆盖-智能切片取样

blocks.en:
The number and longitudinal distribution of usable SAX slices vary across acquisitions. To reduce dependence on a fixed slice configuration, we perform coverage-aware sampling on the physical contours before UV encoding.
Let 𝒱 \mathcal{V} denote the ordered set of valid SAX slices. During training, a subset 𝒱 p ⊆ 𝒱 \mathcal{V}_{p}\subseteq\mathcal{V} is sampled according to the coverage patterns illustrated in Fig. 2 , including full coverage, missing basal or apical slices, retained middle regions, and uniform sparse sampling. The corresponding observation field is written as 𝐗 s , p obs = ℰ ⁡ ( { 𝒞 s , k } k ∈ 𝒱 p , 𝐗 s template ) , \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{obs}}_{s,p}=\mathcal{E}\left(\{\mathcal{C}_{s,k}\}_{k\in\mathcal{V}_{p}};\mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{template}}_{s}\right), (8) where ℰ \mathcal{E} denotes the contour-to-UV encoder.
Because sampling is performed on the physical SAX contours before UV encoding, the resulting inputs preserve realistic longitudinal acquisition patterns. This exposes the network to varying slice coverage during training and improves robustness to incomplete observations.

blocks.en:
The original myocardial surface is closed along the circumferential direction, but cutting it into a rectangular UV domain places anatomically adjacent locations at opposite lateral boundaries. Conventional convolution therefore breaks their intrinsic neighborhood.
To preserve this topology, we introduce Circumferential Wrap Convolution: WrapConv2D ⁡ ( 𝐅 ; 𝐆 ) = 𝐆 ∗ Pad v ⁡ ( Pad u wrap ⁡ ( 𝐅 ) ) , \operatorname{WrapConv2D}(\mathbf{F};\mathbf{G})=\mathbf{G}*\operatorname{Pad}_{v}\left(\operatorname{Pad}^{\mathrm{wrap}}_{u}(\mathbf{F})\right), (11) where 𝐅 \mathbf{F} and 𝐆 \mathbf{G} denote the input feature map and learnable convolution kernel, respectively; periodic padding is applied along the circumferential coordinate u u , and conventional padding along the longitudinal coordinate v v .
WrapConv2D is used throughout the encoder and decoders, enabling multi-scale feature aggregation across the UV seam and maintaining circumferential continuity in the completed surface fields.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Experimental Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和实验议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluated the reconstruction framework on three public cine MRI datasets: ACDC ( Bernard et al., 2018 ) , M & \& Ms ( Campello et al., 2021 ) , and M & \& Ms-2 ( Martín-Isla et al., 2023 ) . ACDC contains SAX cine MRI from 150 cases evenly distributed into five diagnostic categories, including normal subjects (NOR), dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), myocardial infarction with altered left ventricular ejection fraction (MINF), and abnormal right ventricle (ARV).
From M&Ms and M&Ms-2, we included 340 and 350 cases, respectively.
These datasets provide complementary multi-center, multi-vendor, and multi-disease cohorts for evaluating reconstruction under heterogeneous acquisition conditions and cardiac anatomies.
For reconstruction, each dataset was independently split at the subject level into approximately 70 % 70\% training and 30 % 30\% testing, with 20 % 20\% of the training subjects reserved for validation. The test sets remained unseen until final evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了三个公共焚烧磁共振数据集的重建框架:ACDC(Bernard等人,2018年),M & & \& Ms(Campello等人,2021年),M & \& Ms-2(Martín-Isla等人,2023年). ACDC含有150个病例的SAX cine核磁共振,均匀分布在五个诊断类别,包括正常对象(NOR),膨胀心肺病(DCM),超营养心肺病(HCM),心肌梗塞,左心室喷射分数改变(MINF),以及右心室异常(ARV).
从M&M和M&M-2,我们分别包括340和350个案例。
这些数据集提供了多中心、多仇多病的辅助组别,用于评价在不同的购置条件和心脏解剖条件下的重建。
在重建方面,每个数据集在学科一级被独立划分为大约70%的70+\%培训及30%的30+\%测试,20%的20+\%培训科目保留用于验证. 测试集在最后评估之前一直无人知晓。

blocks.en:
For downstream cine MRI-based scar localization (Sec. 4.6.2 ), we additionally used the CineMyoPS dataset from the CARE challenge ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , comprising 64 cases from two centers with cine MRI and manual annotations of the LV, myocardium, and myocardial scar at end diastole. The trained reconstruction model was used to generate UV-domain myocardial surface sequences from cine SAX inputs, from which abnormal motion features were subsequently used for scar prediction.
For UV-domain generative modeling, the reconstructed UV sequences from 270 NOR, DCM, and HCM cases were used to learn disease-conditioned myocardial motion generation, with 216 cases for training and 54 held-out cases for evaluation.

对于紫外线域遗传模型,从270 NOR、DCM和HCM病例中重建的紫外线序列被用于学习疾病条件下的心肌运动生成,其中216例用于培训,54例用于评价。

blocks.en: 4.2 Reference Mesh Construction and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 网目构建和评价

blocks.en:
All methods used SAX contours generated by a fixed pretrained nnU-Net ( Isensee et al., 2021 ) . Patient-specific reference meshes with consistent topology and vertex correspondence were generated offline from the multi-phase SAX contours using a public cardiac atlas ( Bai et al., 2015 ) through global alignment, non-rigid refinement, and temporal smoothing.
Surface agreement with these references was evaluated using symmetric Chamfer distance (CD) and F-score at a 2-mm tolerance (F@2mm). SAX-plane agreement was assessed against the corresponding segmentations using Dice, ASSD, and HD95 after intersecting the reconstructed surfaces with the SAX planes. Cross-phase motion agreement was evaluated using ED-relative motion endpoint error (EPE) ( qiao2020temporally ) at corresponding UV locations.
Functional agreement was evaluated using end-diastolic volume (EDV) and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF).
For the ablation studies, we additionally report UV MSE, measuring coordinate-field reconstruction error over the valid UV domain, and Edge Ratio P95, measuring high-percentile local mesh distortion relative to the reference surface.
blocks.zh:
所有方法都使用由固定的预先训练的nnU-Net生成的SAX轮廓(Isensee等人,2021年). 使用公共心脏图集(Bai等人,2015年),通过全球对齐、非刚性改进和时间平滑,从多阶段SAX轮廓线下生成了具有一致地形和顶点对应的患者专用参照网。
使用对称的Chamfer距离(CD)和F-score在2毫米耐受度(F@2mm)上对表面协议进行了评价。 在重建的表面与SAX飞机相交后,用Dice,ASSD和HD95来对照相应的分区评估SAX飞机协议. 在相应的紫外线位置使用ED相对运动端点误差(EPE)(qiao2020即时)对跨相运动协议进行了评价.
对功能协议进行了评估,使用了端膜体积(EDV)和左心室喷射分数(LVEF).
对于衰减研究,我们额外报告UV MSE,测量有效紫外线域上的坐标-场重建错误,以及Edge 比率P95,测量相对于参考表面的高百分率局部网格扭曲.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.3 执行情况

blocks.en:
All experiments were implemented in PyTorch and conducted on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU.
All coordinate fields were represented on a 256 × 256 256\times 256 canonical UV grid, with an aggregation bandwidth of β = 0.06 \beta=0.06 .
The concatenated epicardial and endocardial fields formed a six-channel input to a seam-aware 2D U-Net with a shared encoder and surface-specific decoders.
Separate models were trained from scratch for ACDC, M&Ms, and M&Ms-2 using full- and incomplete-coverage samples generated by coverage-aware sampling.
AdamW was used with a batch size of 16 16 , learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and cosine annealing; training lasted 48,000 48{,}000 , 75,000 75{,}000 , and 80,000 80{,}000 steps, respectively.
The surface-wide and region-focused loss weights were set to ( 0.01 , 0.1 , 0.003 , 0.001 ) (0.01,0.1,0.003,0.001) and ( 0.04 , 0.005 , 0.003 , 0.002 ) (0.04,0.005,0.003,0.002) , respectively, with region weights ( 1.00 , 0.75 , 0.50 , 0.25 ) (1.00,0.75,0.50,0.25) .
Checkpoints were selected using the validation set only.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 比较研究

blocks.en:
We compared with four representative approaches reproducible under the same sparse-SAX setting: Voxel2Mesh ( Wickramasinghe et al., 2020 ) , using volumetric features for mesh deformation; a PN-GCN baseline implemented in this study, encoding the same contours as unordered point features without explicit UV correspondence; 4DMM ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) , using implicit shape and motion fields; and GHDHeart ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , combining differentiable slicing with global mesh deformation. All trainable baselines were retrained using the same subject-level splits. As shown in Table 1 , our method achieved the best surface reconstruction accuracy on all three datasets.
The CD values were 2.887 2.887 mm on ACDC, 2.641 2.641 mm on M & \& Ms, and 2.810 2.810 mm on M & \& Ms-2, with corresponding F@2mm values of 0.796 0.796 , 0.839 0.839 , and 0.817 0.817 .
Our method significantly outperformed the best baseline on both metrics across all datasets (Holm-corrected paired Wilcoxon tests, p ≤ 0.005 p\leq 0.005 ).
The qualitative results in Fig. 3 (a) further demonstrated stable recovery of disease-specific ED and ES morphologies.
Compared with these approaches, the proposed contour-to-UV encoding explicitly associates sparse SAX observations with anatomically corresponding surface locations before completion, allowing local contour evidence to directly guide structured surface prediction.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study

blocks.en:
Tables 3 and 4 evaluated the contributions of centerline alignment, coverage-aware training, region-focused supervision, and WrapConv2D.
The Rigid / Full-only and Centerline / Full-only variants were trained only with full-coverage samples, whereas the complete model incorporated all proposed components.
Results were pooled over five coverage patterns and jointly computed for the epicardial and endocardial surfaces using UV MSE, CD, and Edge Ratio P95, where values closer to 1 1 indicated lower local edge distortion.
The complete model achieved the best performance across all three metrics.
Compared with Centerline / Full-only , it reduced UV MSE and CD by 67.3 % 67.3\% and 15.3 % 15.3\% , respectively.
Table 4 and Fig. 5 (a) showed that coverage-aware training caused only a minor change under full coverage but consistently improved all incomplete-coverage settings.
The largest gain occurred for the mid-block pattern, where UV MSE and CD were reduced by 91.1 % 91.1\% and 56.3 % 56.3\% , respectively, demonstrating improved robustness to base-missing, apex-missing, mid-block, and uniformly sparse SAX inputs.

刚性/全覆盖和中线/全覆盖的变体只接受了全覆盖样本的培训,而完整的模型包含所有拟议组成部分。
利用UV MSE、CD和Edge Brible P95对心外膜和心内膜表面进行了联合计算,其中数值接近1 1 的数值显示局部边缘扭曲程度较低。
完整的模型在所有三个衡量标准上都取得了最佳业绩。
与Centerline / Full-Only相比,它分别将UV MSE和CD减少了67.3% 67.3\%和15.3% 15.3\%.
表4和图5(a)显示,了解覆盖面的培训只在全覆盖范围内造成小幅变化,但持续改善所有不完整的覆盖环境。
最大的收益来自中段模式,其中紫外线MSE和CD分别减少了91.1%、91.1%和56.3%、56.3%,表明对基数缺失、顶数缺失、中段和统一稀疏的SAX投入的强度有所提高。

blocks.en:
The similar performance of the two full-only variants suggested that both rigid and centerline alignment supported reliable reconstruction under complete coverage. Centerline alignment was nevertheless retained to provide a consistent geometric basis for correspondence retrieval across slices and subjects.
As shown in Fig. 5 (b), the learned UV-domain completion model also preserved globally smooth and coherent surfaces in the presence of local contour misalignment or irregular variation.
Fig. 5 (c) further showed that direct UV interpolation produced stripe-like artifacts and that direct conversion of 𝐗 obs \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{obs}} recovered only locally observed geometry, whereas the proposed network generated complete and smooth myocardial surfaces.
WrapConv2D improved continuity across the circumferential seam, while region-focused supervision reduced triangle stretching and distortion near the apex. These observations were consistent with the improvements in UV MSE and Edge Ratio P95 and indicated that global CD alone did not fully reflect localized geometric defects.
blocks.zh:
两种完全的变体的类似表现表明,刚性线和中线线对接都支持在完全覆盖下进行可靠的重建. 尽管如此,仍保留了中线对齐,为各个切片和主题的通信检索提供一致的几何基础。
如图5(b)所示,学习到的紫外线域完成模型在局部轮廓错位或不规则变异的情况下,也保留了全球光滑而连贯的表面.
图5 (c)进一步表明,直接紫外线插值会产生类似条纹的文物,直接转换X obs\mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{obs}}只恢复了局部观测到的几何,而拟议的网络则产生完整和光滑的心肌表面.
CrawConv2D改善了整个环形接缝的连续性,而以区域为重点的监督则减少了顶端附近的三角拉伸和扭曲。 这些意见与紫外线MSE和边缘比P95的改进一致,并表明仅全球CD并不能充分反映局部几何缺陷.

blocks.en: 4.6 Utility of the Canonical UV Representation
blocks.zh: 4.6 加尼科紫外线代表机构的效用

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Myocardial Shape and Functional Quantification
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 心肌形状和功能量化

blocks.en:
The reconstructed surfaces were used to derive frame-wise LV volume and global wall-thickening trajectories, with wall thickening computed from temporal changes in the paired epicardial-endocardial distances on the shared UV domain.
As shown in Fig. 6 (a), the predicted curves closely followed the references throughout the cardiac cycle and preserved disease-specific patterns, including enlarged ventricular volumes and reduced wall thickening in DCM and MINF, and increased thickening in HCM. Across the three datasets, the case-level motion EPE was 1.297 ± 0.643 1.297\pm 0.643 mm, indicating accurate point-wise motion across cardiac phases.
Fig. 6 (b) further showed strong agreement in functional measurements across the three datasets, with an EDV MAE of 3.3 3.3 mL ( R 2 = 0.991 R^{2}=0.991 ) and an LVEF MAE of 1.1 % 1.1\% ( R 2 = 0.988 R^{2}=0.988 ).
These results demonstrated that the reconstructed 4D surfaces preserved both disease-related myocardial dynamics and clinically relevant ventricular function.
blocks.zh:
重建的表面用于得出帧式LV体积和全球墙壁推重轨迹,墙壁加厚是根据共用紫外线域上对称的心动距离的时间变化计算的。
如图6(a)所示,预测曲线密切跟踪整个心脏周期的参考文献,并保存了与疾病有关的具体模式,包括扩大口腔体积和减少DCM和MINF的墙壁加厚,以及增加HCM加厚。 在三个数据集中,病例级运动的ETE为1.297±0.643 1.297\pm 0.643毫米,表明精确的点心运动跨越心脏阶段.
图6(b)进一步显示,在三个数据集的功能测量中,EDV MAE为3.33.3 mL(R 2 = 0.991 R^{2 }=0.991),LVEF MAE为1.1 % 1.1 \%(R 2 = 0.988 R^{2 }=0.988))。
这些结果表明,重建后的4D表面既保留了与疾病有关的心肌动力学,又保留了临床相关的心室功能.

blocks.en: 4.6.2 UV-Domain Myocardial Scar Localization from Cine MRI
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 磁共振磁共振中的紫外线-域膜心肌疤局部化

blocks.en:
To further investigate whether the reconstructed 4D myocardial geometry captured clinically relevant regional motion abnormalities, we evaluated myocardial scar footprint localization on the independent CineMyoPS dataset ( Ding et al., 2025 ) .
Here, the scar footprint referred to the surface region obtained by projecting the myocardial scar along the wall onto the corresponding myocardial surface. From the reconstructed epicardial and endocardial sequences, we derived motion amplitude, fractional wall thickening, and cumulative displacement over the cardiac cycle.
These features were compared with a healthy motion atlas constructed from approximately 200 normal cases to identify anatomically localized reductions in contraction.
Because the reconstructed surfaces maintained point-wise correspondence across cardiac phases and subjects, the resulting abnormal-motion patterns could be directly mapped to LGE-derived scar regions in the shared UV domain.
A lightweight predictor with WrapConv2D subsequently converted these motion-abnormality maps into continuous scar-footprint probability maps.
As shown in Fig. 7 , the predicted scar footprints were spatially consistent with the references in the AHA-17 representation, UV domain, and reconstructed 3D myocardium, indicating that the reconstructed 4D geometry preserved regional motion characteristics relevant to myocardial scar localization.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步调查重建的4D心肌几何是否捕捉到临床相关的区域运动异常,我们评价了独立的CineMyoPS数据集上的心肌疤痕本地化(Ding等人,2025年)。
这里的伤疤足迹是指通过将壁沿的心肌伤痕投射到相应的心肌表面而获得的表面区域. 从心跳和心内分泌序列中, 我们得出了运动振幅, 分壁增厚, 以及心脏循环的累积转移。
这些特征与从大约200个正常病例中绘制的健康运动图集作了比较,以确定解剖局部收缩的减少。
由于重建的表面在心脏阶段和主体之间保持了点向对应,因此由此产生的异常运动模式可以直接映射到共享紫外线域LGE衍生的疤痕区域.
一个带有CrapConv2D的轻量级预测器随后将这些运动异常图转换成连续的疤足概率图.
如图7所示,预测的疤痕足迹在空间上与AHA-17代表物,紫外线域的引用一致,并重建了3D心肌,表明重建的4D几何保存了与心肌疤痕局部化相关的区域运动特征.

blocks.en: 4.6.3 UV-Domain Generative Modeling
blocks.zh: 4.6.3 紫外线领域基因模型

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the broader utility of the canonical UV representation, temporally aligned epicardial and endocardial motion was converted into regular UV displacement fields and modeled using a sequence VAE followed by a conditional latent diffusion model (LDM). Each UV sequence was first decomposed into the ED UV anatomy and 24 frames of ED-relative motion. The VAE compressed each 24 × 6 × 256 × 256 24\times 6\times 256\times 256 motion sequence into an 8 × 32 × 32 8\times 32\times 32 latent code. Conditioned on the ED UV and disease label, the LDM then generated a motion latent, which was decoded by the frozen VAE decoder and added back to the ED anatomy to recover a complete 25-frame UV sequence.
Although the VAE was optimized solely for motion reconstruction, its latent space retained clear disease-related structure. As shown in Fig. 8 (a), NOR, DCM, and HCM exhibit distinguishable distributions along the first two linear discriminant axes. A classification probe trained on the motion latents achieved a held-out macro-F1 of 0.776 0.776 and a balanced accuracy of 0.778 0.778 , indicating that the shared UV correspondence organizes temporal motion into a compact representation with consistent spatial semantics while preserving disease-related motion characteristics.
The LDM generated complete 25-frame motion sequences for all held-out cases, achieving an overall CD of 3.929 3.929 mm. Fig. 8 (b) further shows that the generated sequences preserve the characteristic LV cavity-volume patterns of NOR, DCM, and HCM and remain consistent with the reference distributions. These results demonstrate that the canonical UV representation not only provides consistent anatomical correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases, but also enables conventional 2D generative models to capture disease-related 4D myocardial motion while retaining geometric and functional fidelity after reconstruction in 3D.
blocks.zh:
为了证明罐装紫外线表示的更广泛的效用,时间对齐的心动和心内运动被转换为常规紫外线转移场,并使用一个序列VAE和随后的有条件潜在扩散模型(LDM)进行建模. 每个紫外线序列首先分解为ED紫外线解剖学和24帧ED相对运动. VAE压缩每架24×6×256×256 24\time 6\time 256\time 256运动序列成8×32×32 8\time 32\time 32潜伏码. 在ED紫外线和疾病标签上附加条件,LDM随即产生一个运动潜伏,由冰冻的VAE解码器解码,并添加回ED解剖学中以恢复完整的25帧紫外线序列.
尽管对自愿医疗设备进行了优化,仅用于运动重建,但其潜在空间保留了与疾病有关的明确结构。 如图8(a)所示,NOR、DCM和HCM沿前两个线性歧视轴显示可区分的分布。 接受过运动潜质培训的分类探测器实现了0.776 0.776的悬浮宏-F1和0.778 0.778的平衡精确度,表明共享的紫外线通信在保留与疾病有关的运动特性的同时,将时间运动组织成一个具有一致空间语义的紧凑的表示.
LDM为所有被搁置的病例生成完整的25帧运动序列,总体CD达到3.929 3.929毫米. 图8(b)进一步显示,生成的序列保持了NOR,DCM和HCM的特征LV腔积图案,并且与参考分布保持一致. 这些结果表明,舟形紫外线的表示不仅提供了各主体和心脏阶段的一致解剖对应,而且还使常规的2D基因模型能够捕捉与疾病有关的4D心肌运动,同时在3D重建后保留几何和功能上的忠诚.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
This study introduced an anatomy-aligned UV representation for patient-specific 4D myocardial reconstruction from sparse SAX cine MRI. By unfolding the epicardial and endocardial surfaces onto a shared circumferential-longitudinal domain, the framework transformed the irregular 3D reconstruction problem into structured two-dimensional coordinate-field completion and directly associated sparse observations with anatomically corresponding surface locations. This shared organization preserved explicit anatomical correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases.
The method achieved the best surface accuracy across ACDC, M&Ms, and M&Ms-2 with an inference time of only 0.8 0.8 s per frame, and showed particularly strong performance on the more heterogeneous M&Ms cohorts. The close agreement in EDV and LVEF, with MAEs of 3.3 3.3 mL and 1.1 % 1.1\% , respectively, further indicated that the reconstructed sequences preserved clinically relevant ventricular geometry and function.
blocks.zh:
这项研究引入了解剖学与紫外线结合的表示法,用于从稀少的SAX Cine核磁共振中进行针对患者的4D心肌重建. 通过将心动和内心表面向一个共享的环绕-纵向域展开,框架将不规则的立体重建问题转变为结构化的二维坐标场完成,并与解剖对应的表面位置直接关联的稀疏观测. 这一共同组织在学科和心脏阶段之间保持了明确的解剖联系。
该方法实现了全ACDC、M&Ms和M&Ms-2的最好的表面精度,每个框架的推断时间仅为0.8秒,并显示出在更为多样化的M&M组中表现特别强。 EDV和LVEF的密切协议,分别与3.33.3 mL和1.1% 1.1% 的MAEs,进一步表明重建的序列保留了临床相关的通风几何和功能.

blocks.en: The experimental results clarified the contributions of the individual components. Coverage-aware sampling provided the largest improvement by reducing dependence on a fixed longitudinal slice distribution; compared with full-coverage training, it substantially improved reconstruction under missing basal, apical, mid-block, and uniformly sparse observations. WrapConv2D maintained continuity across the circumferential seam, whereas region-focused supervision reduced localized distortion near the apex, demonstrating that global surface-distance metrics alone were insufficient to characterize geometric quality in parameterization-sensitive regions. Beyond reconstruction, the shared UV correspondence supported several complementary applications. The reconstructed 4D geometry captured regional reductions in motion and wall thickening that could be mapped to LGE-derived scar regions in the independent CineMyoPS cohort. The same representation also converted myocardial motion into regular UV displacement fields compatible with conventional VAE and latent diffusion architectures. The resulting latent features retained disease-related motion information, while the generated trajectories preserved both surface geometry and global ventricular function. Together, these experiments showed that the canonical UV domain served not only as a reconstruction space but also as a common representation for functional analysis, pathology localization, and generative modeling.
blocks.zh: 实验结果澄清了各个组成部分的贡献。 了解覆盖范围的取样通过减少对固定纵向片状分布的依赖,提供了最大的改进;与全面覆盖培训相比,它大大改进了在缺少的玄武岩、阿皮卡、中段地带和普遍稀少的观测下进行的重建。 BrashConv2D保持了环形接缝的连续性,而以区域为重点的监督则减少了顶端附近的局部扭曲,表明光是全球地表-距离测量不足以描述参数化敏感区域的几何质量。 除了重建外,共用的紫外线通信还支持若干辅助应用。 重建后的4D几何图案捕捉到区域运动减少和墙壁加厚,可绘制成独立CineMyops组群LGE产生的疤痕区域。 该代表还将心肌运动转化为符合常规紫外线辐射和潜在扩散结构的常规紫外线转移场。 由此产生的潜在特征保留了与疾病有关的运动信息,而产生的轨迹既保留了表面几何功能,也保留了全球通风功能。 这些实验合在一起表明,犬形紫外线域不仅作为重建空间,而且作为功能分析、病理局部化和基因模型化的共同代表。

blocks.en:
Several limitations remain.
Separate models were trained for each dataset, and the current formulation focused on the left-ventricular myocardium; extending the framework to a unified multi-dataset model and more complex whole-heart anatomy will require additional parameterization strategies. Although periodic convolution and region-focused constraints reduced seam and apical artifacts, reconstruction quality still depended on the canonical template and its UV mapping. The scar-localization experiment was primarily qualitative and used LGE-derived labels for supervision, while the generative evaluation involved a relatively small cohort containing only NOR, DCM, and HCM cases.
Future work should employ larger external cohorts and include quantitative scar assessment, uncertainty estimation, and evaluation in downstream simulation and prognostic tasks. Despite these limitations, anatomy-aligned UV surface-field learning provided an accurate, efficient, and extensible framework for correspondence-aware 4D myocardial reconstruction from sparse cine MRI.
blocks.zh:
仍然存在若干限制。
为每个数据集培训了单独的模型,目前的配方侧重于左脉心肌;将框架扩展到统一的多数据集模型和更复杂的全心解剖需要额外的参数化策略. 虽然定期演变和以地区为重点的限制减少了缝隙和阿皮卡文物,但重建质量仍取决于舟体模板及其紫外线绘图。 疤痕局部化实验主要是定性的,并使用LGE衍生的标签进行监督,而基因评价涉及的组群相对较小,只包含NOR、DCM和HCM病例。
今后的工作应利用更多的外部群体,并在下游模拟和预测任务中包括伤疤定量评估、不确定性估计和评价。 尽管有这些限制,解剖学与紫外线相适应的地表野外学习提供了一个准确、高效和可扩展的框架,用于从稀薄的焚化磁共振中进行通信意识4D心肌重建。
